collections.title: Earth as a System · Energy and Circulation
collections.summary: Connect planetary radiative exchange to the winds and ocean currents that redistribute energy.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Where Water Travels
collections.summary: Follow water and its energy from winds through rainfall, groundwater and ocean circulation.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Four Foundations
collections.summary: The original four-part foundation: radiation, moving atmosphere, water and ocean circulation.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Carbon, Ice and Moving Land
collections.summary: Follow carbon exchange and geological weathering, frozen water and ice sheets, and how rivers and slopes move matter.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Carbon from Soil to Stone
collections.summary: Link fast biological/ocean carbon exchange with river sediment and geological weathering.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Water Frozen and Flowing
collections.summary: Water moves through rainfall, ocean circulation, snow, glacier ice and sea ice.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Ocean, Atmosphere, ENSO
collections.summary: From the Pacific mean state and Bjerknes coupling to atmospheric teleconnections and probabilistic seasonal prediction.

collections.title: Earth as a System · The Three ENSO Lectures
collections.summary: A focused sequence on ENSO dynamics, the distant reach of tropical convection, and observation-based seasonal forecasts.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Weather at Its Limits
collections.summary: A five-lecture sequence on organized thunderstorms, cyclone hazards, atmospheric rivers and floods, drought, and extreme heat, with observation and attribution limits.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Too Much and Too Little Water
collections.summary: A water-budget path connecting the hydrological foundation to atmospheric rivers, flood storage and drought demand.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Climate and Extreme Events
collections.summary: How physical mechanisms, event attribution and exposure intersect in cyclone rainfall, drought, extreme heat and intense convection.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Earth's Living Chemistry
collections.summary: Four connected lectures on reactive nitrogen, rock-derived phosphorus, oxygen across timescales, and wetland-to-coastal redox chemistry.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Nutrients from Watersheds to Seas
collections.summary: How moving water carries nitrogen and phosphorus from rocks and soils to lakes, estuaries and low-oxygen coastal habitats.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Oxygen, Past and Present
collections.summary: From ocean circulation and oxygenation history to oxygen-deficient sediments and coastal shelves.

collections.title: Earth as a System · How We Know the Climate Past
collections.summary: Read the physical archives and construct their chronologies before comparing regional and global climate histories.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Dating and Reconstructing
collections.summary: Crossdating, radiocarbon and uranium-series clocks, age-model assumptions and multi-proxy reconstruction.

collections.title: Earth as a System · How Models Work
collections.summary: A six-part introduction to numerical modeling, unresolved physics, coupling, assimilation, experimental design and critical evaluation.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Models, Evidence and Prediction
collections.summary: Follow observations and model reasoning from ENSO forecasting and climate archives into assimilation, numerical experiments and independent tests.

collections.title: Earth as a System · From Budgets to Projections
collections.summary: From radiation budgets to grid-scale conservation, subgrid physics, coupled components, projections and uncertainty.

collections.title: Earth as a System · The Changing Coast
collections.summary: Tides, wave transport, barrier islands, estuaries, and delta elevation budgets.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Sediment from Mountains to Sea
collections.summary: Connect landscape sediment supply to beach drift, migrating barriers and delta building.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Ocean Water at the Coast
collections.summary: Tides, estuarine density circulation, oxygen and sediment movement through coastal waters.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Water Beneath the Land
collections.summary: Four lectures on aquifer hydraulic physics, exchanges with rivers, pumping and subsidence, and groundwater age and quality.

collections.title: Earth as a System · From Rain to Rivers and Wells
collections.summary: Connect atmospheric moisture and the water cycle to subsurface storage, river exchange and aquifer drawdown.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Coupled Climate Beyond the Basics
collections.summary: Five connected explanations of seasonal monsoons, atmospheric oxidation and aerosols, deep ocean overturning and land feedbacks.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Why Rain Belts Move
collections.summary: From atmospheric circulation and ENSO to seasonal monsoon rainfall and aerosol-driven hemispheric energy contrasts.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Chemistry of the Sky
collections.summary: Atmospheric nitrogen and oxygen cycling, reactive-gas ozone chemistry and aerosol cloud interactions.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Ocean Mixing and Memory
collections.summary: Ocean stratification, carbon and oxygen budgets, circulation and tracer records of deep-water ventilation.

collections.title: Earth as a System · Land, Water, and Extreme Heat
collections.summary: Water budget and drought, humid heat, groundwater and vegetation regulation of the surface energy balance.
